title: Inventory Value report still lists a part after it is set inactive
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVKEEP-01) is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin at Cost $12.50, so its stock is worth $50.00 (4 × $12.50).
  • The Inventory Value report total for today at {Location-A}, read while {Part-A} was active, is {Total-A} (for example $10,450.00).
  • {Part-A} was set inactive after that reading.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Reports → Inventory Value for today at {Location-A}.
  2. Search {Part-A}.
  3. Clear the search and read the report total.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {Part-A} is listed with quantity 4 and value $50.00 (4 × $12.50).
  • Step 3: The total equals {Total-A} (a difference of $0.00). If someone else changed stock at {Location-A} in the meantime, compare the {Part-A} row only and say so in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-E11, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows the report. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E11: “Reports keep inactive parts. Inventory Value and Parts Velocity include them, because their stock still has value and their history still happened.”
